build_MoCo_model: build a MoCo model with query and key encoders, a queue, and momentum update for contrastive learning
run_MoCo_forward: run the MoCo forward pass with query and key image batches to compute logits and labels
test_momentum_update_key_encoder: test the MoCo momentum update of the key encoder using the momentum coefficient
review_dequeue_and_enqueue: review the MoCo dequeue and enqueue method that manages the negative key queue buffer
summarize_concat_all_gather: summarize the concat_all_gather utility that gathers tensors across all GPUs via distributed all_gather
